BREAKING: The Consumer Sentiment Index fell -3.6 points in September, to 48.1, its 2nd-lowest level in history.

This comes as the Current Conditions Index decreased -1.0 point, to 50.9, its 4th-lowest reading

Mortgage rates were 3.5%

Gas is almost $5 a gallon
Inflation is 3.4%
Unemployment is now over 4%

What happened?
